serverRenderedJsonLd.description: Sharda Social is a student social media community and free online library for Sharda University — find previous year question papers, semester notes and syllabus PDFs, and follow campus announcements, events, opportunities and lost & found.

acceptedAnswer.text: Sharda Social is a free, student-run platform for Sharda University, Greater Noida. It combines an online library of previous year question papers, semester notes and syllabus PDFs with a campus feed where students post announcements, events, opportunities and lost & found items. It is independent and not an official university website.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find Sharda University previous year question papers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every past paper is in the PYQs section of the library. You can filter by programme, semester, academic year or course code, or search by subject name — for example 'operating systems' or 'CSE252'. The collection covers all nine schools, including engineering, law, pharmacy, nursing, medical, dental, allied health, humanities and education.

mainEntity.name: Are Sharda University notes and syllabus available too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Notes section holds unit-wise study notes shared by students, and the Syllabus section holds the official unit breakdown for each course, so you can see exactly what is examinable before you start revising.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an account to use the Sharda online library?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Sign in with a free Sharda account using your @ug.sharda.ac.in email to browse, search and download the library's study material.

mainEntity.name: Is Sharda Social free to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, completely. It is built and run by Sharda students, and there is no charge for browsing or downloading anything in the library.

mainEntity.name: Can I contribute my own notes or question papers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and it is the main way the library grows. Sign in with your Sharda email and upload from your dashboard. Uploads are checked by a moderator before they go live, so the library stays accurate and relevant.
